import json, os, urllib.error, urllib.request
auth = os.environ["GW_TOKEN"].strip()
if not auth.lower().startswith("bearer"):
    auth = "Bearer " + auth

def avail(body):
    req = urllib.request.Request("https://mott-booking-gw.mail.mybcat.com/availability", data=json.dumps(body).encode(), method="POST", headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "User-Agent": "mybcat-cli", "Authorization": auth})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=120) as r:
            res = (json.loads(r.read().decode() or "{}").get("result") or {})
        return res.get("count"), [s.get("start") for s in (res.get("slots") or [])][:3]
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        return "HTTP_%s" % e.code, [e.read().decode(errors="replace")[:120]]

base = {"store": "711", "from": "thursday", "to": "thursday", "slot_minutes": "15", "after": "none", "before": "none", "time_pref": "none"}
c1, s1 = avail(base)
print("DEFAULT count=%s first3=%s" % (c1, s1))
c2, s2 = avail({**base, "time_pref": "latest"})
print("LATEST  count=%s first3=%s" % (c2, s2))
c3, s3 = avail({**base, "time_pref": "anchor=12:00"})
print("ANCHOR  count=%s first3=%s" % (c3, s3))
if isinstance(c2, str):
    print("VERDICT: LATEST-MODE-ERRORS (%s)" % c2)
elif s1 and s2 and s2[0] != s1[0] and str(s2[0]) > str(s1[0]):
    print("VERDICT: LATEST-WORKS default_first=%s latest_first=%s" % (s1[0], s2[0]))
elif s1 and s2 and s2[0] == s1[0]:
    print("VERDICT: LATEST-IGNORED (same first slot as default - lane-38 ordering not active on this path)")
else:
    print("VERDICT: INCONCLUSIVE s1=%s s2=%s" % (s1[:1], s2[:1]))
print("PROBE_DONE")
PY
